data.claim: Idempotency is a property of an operation applied to the same input state (does doing it twice from the original state equal once?), while safety is a property of an operation applied after its own prior execution (does doing it again after already having done it cause harm?). For an append-only log, the writers must be safe rather than strictly idempotent, relying on deduplication or content addressing to ensure that duplicate entries do not corrupt the replayed state.
